name: FranConnect
oneLiner: Franchise and multi-location management platform covering franchise development, onboarding, training, field operations, royalties and franchisee support, with Frannie AI agents.
bestFor: Franchisors and multi-unit restaurant brands that want one system for the franchisor-franchisee relationship, from recruiting candidates to audits and royalties.

updates.text: Launched Frannie AI, a suite of generative AI agents for franchise sales, operations, finance and training, later rolled out to Australian customers as a subscription.
Added a Candidate Coach AI assistant for franchise development, standardized project tracking for operations, and access to Training & Development (World Manager) inside the FranConnect app.

Franchisee Support Agent that answers franchisee questions with citations from the brand's approved Hub content (listed as upcoming in the October 2026 release notes; a mobile version of the support agent shipped in May 2026).

features: Franchise development CRM for candidate leads and deal pipeline, with an AI candidate coach
New-unit onboarding and opening project tracking
Training and learning content (World Manager) inside the app
Field operations: audits, inspections and corrective tasks linked to audit questions
Royalty reporting plus AR aging and collections dashboards
Franchisee communication hub and AI support agent with cited answers
Marketing campaign dashboard and combined lead/unit map
Integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce, QuickBooks and POS systems

pricing.text: Custom pricing; FranConnect does not publish prices.

notes: Active and shipping monthly releases (help.franconnect.com release notes Feb-Oct 2026). CEO Gabby Wong (IFA 2026 event page). Subway is from FranConnect's Jan 2025 release on 2024 results ('welcomed three of the largest global franchise concepts, including Subway'); current use not reconfirmed. FranConnect says it works with nearly 1,500 multi-location brands (self-reported). Dropped from current review: '1.3 million locations', 'over 20 years', and the unverified restaurant list Wing Zone/QDOBA/Taco John's/Tijuana Flats/HOA Brands (Wing Zone appears with Capriotti's on the testimonials page; the others were not confirmed). Integration list (HubSpot, QuickBooks, Salesforce) carried from the current review, not re-verified. Fits franchisors more than single-brand operators.
